'''Clue scroll (hard)''' is a [[cryptic clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (hard)|hard]] [[Treasure Trails]].

==Clue info==
{{Clue info
|id = 635
|text = The clue reveals where to search:<br><br>I have many arms but legs, I have just one. I have little family but my seed you can grow on, I am not dead, yet I am but a spirit, and my power, on your quests, you will earn the right to free it.
|notes = Talk to the [[spirit tree]] in [[Tree Gnome Village (location)|Tree Gnome Village]].

Question: ''What is the next number in the sequence? 1, 11, 21, 1211, 111221, 312211''
